title: {{alliance}} · Alliance troops
rules: Borrow equipped normal troops for a limited campaign. Survivors return on expiry, recall, leaving or expulsion. Wounded troops return wounded. Combat deaths carry no penalty. Return alliance troops before targeting any member of their alliance.
emptyPool: The reserve is empty. Contribute existing equipped troops below.
permanentWarning: This permanently transfers your trained troops and one owned item in every supported slot for each troop to the alliance. You cannot reclaim a donation when you leave.
confirmContribution: I understand these troops and items become alliance property.
emptyLoans: No active loans or pending requests.
taxRule: General pillage tax and participating offensive-loan contributions use the higher rate. All alliances combined can collect at most 25% of gross pillage. Gold-loan repayment applies afterward.
pillageRateBps: general pillage tax in basis points
basisPoints: 100 basis points = 1%. A role without an automatic allowance cannot borrow automatically. Existing contracts retain their accepted contribution rate.
loadError: Unable to load alliance troops. Reload to retry.
orderError: Unable to process this order. Refresh before retrying.

dues.title: Dues, levies and fines
dues.explanation: Pay gold or existing fully equipped troops manually, including partial payments. A combat death never creates a debt. Outstanding obligations are cancelled when membership ends.
dues.overdueWarning_one: You have {{count}} overdue obligation. Review the alliance enforcement settings below.
dues.overdueWarning_other: You have {{count}} overdue obligations. Review the alliance enforcement settings below.
dues.enforcementWarning: Overdue borrowing suspension: {{suspend}}. Automatic collection after: {{collect}} days. One-time fine: {{fine}} gold. Expulsion after: {{expel}} days. Enforcement runs on the daily tick.
dues.empty: No dues or levies have been issued.
dues.designateExplanation: Only designated eligible permanent troops can be auto-collected. Equipment must still be owned when collection runs. Designated stack: {{unit}}.
dues.levyRules: A levy targets selected current members with an explicit due date. Recurring rules apply by alliance role and player level. Payments do not come from loaned or mercenary troops.
dues.levelRule: The highest qualifying minimum-level rule applies within each role. A missed scheduler run issues one current demand, without back-charging missed periods.
dues.ruleSummary: Level {{level}}+, every {{interval}} days, due within {{due}} days
dues.suspend: Suspend new borrowing and extensions while dues or fines are overdue
dues.autoCollect: Automatically collect overdue payments on the daily tick
dues.expel: Expel members who remain overdue after the grace period
dues.policyWarning: Automatic collection uses on-hand gold and designated equipped permanent troops only. Shortfalls remain due. Fines never compound. Expulsion returns surviving alliance loans and never triggers an attack.
dues.conditions: Accepted terms: collect after {{collect}} days; one-time fine {{fine}} gold; expel after {{expel}} days.
